Tags: xml.sequenceOffset=40 Table 7.4: SporadicEventTriggering This is a generalization of the periodic event triggering described in subsection 7.1.1. The difference is that the event can, but not necessarily must occur. For this rea- son, there is one additional parameter required for the specification of the Spo- radicEventTriggering, namely the maximumInterArrivalTime, which spec- ifies the largest possible time distance between two event occurrences.
